sectionHeadings: ## 1.3 Promesse publique compatible avec l'état prouvé

globalRules.productPromise: Every object must help the player understand why the fortress worked or failed, make a meaningful preparation decision, and want to test the revised hypothesis again.
globalRules.retentionRole: Visual identity, readable causality, persistent fortress authorship and recoverable failure must reinforce autonomy, competence, relation and an obvious next attempt.
readability: Function, front, interaction, danger and current state remain understandable in one second on the weakest supported mobile view.
Silhouette and value hierarchy carry meaning before color, texture, particles or text.
Spectacle may amplify an event but may never obscure direction, target, cause or priority.
The fortress remains the protagonist: player-built objects read as authored tools, not anonymous scenery.
failureLanguage: Damage exposes a plausible structural cause instead of adding arbitrary noise.
Every worsening state preserves the object's identity while revealing a more legible weakness.
Failure is spectacular but recoverable; permanent visual loss never erases the player's ownership story.
Every break points toward an actionable lesson for the next preparation phase.
globalRules.productionRule: Exploration decides the object; production reconstructs the accepted canon and is forbidden from filling unspecified gaps by probability or decorative invention.

hordeLearning.rule: Art may support readable enemy behavior, but it may not claim or market an adaptive learning horde until H-HORDE-001 passes its gate.
